author: 滇西小哥 Dianxi Xiaoge
description:
※Click "cc" on the lower right menu to choose your subtitle language.

Edamame are soybeans in their youth. Different stages mean different flavors—and different ways to eat them. Fresh edamame are crisp, tender, and naturally sweet; once boiled, they’re as sweet as candy beans. They’re delicious stir-fried with meat, pounded fresh, or simmered into soups.
When soybeans fully mature, they’re made into tofu—soft, fragrant, and sweet. Fry the tofu until golden, soak it overnight in natural alkaline earth, then cook it: that’s Pocket Tofu—chewy outside, creamy inside, a signature specialty of Jinj i in Baoshan.
So which one do you love most?

Hello, everyone! I am Dianxi Xiaoge, a Yunnan native. If you enjoy my videos, please keep subscribing to my channel. I'll continue to share my life and Yunnan-styled food in my uploads. Wish you have a happy life and enjoy tasty food every day
